pattern_explanation: Several Ukrainian words look close to English words but carry a different meaning. Learners often expect the English look-alike to mean the same thing, so the pairing has to be learned as a separate meaning.
false_friend_warning: False friend trap: the Ukrainian word for an embarrassing situation looks like the English word 'confusion', but it means embarrassment. The Ukrainian word for relevant or current looks like the English word 'actual', which means real, so learners may pick the wrong English meaning.
